title: Zhang--Feng--Khandelwal finite-strain periodic composite, Table 5
purpose: Provide an independent, fail-closed structure-level promotion gate for regional finite-strain J2 periodic-cell analysis without embedding external answers in solver logic.
physics: Plane-strain periodic composite with two stiff circular inclusions, one circular void, logarithmic finite-strain J2 matrix plasticity, elastic inclusions, and macroscopic simple shear.

source.authors: J. Zhang, X. Feng and K. Khandelwal
source.title: A computational framework for homogenization and multiscale stability analyses of nonlinear periodic materials
source.journal: International Journal for Numerical Methods in Engineering 122 (2021), 6527--6575
source.reference: Section 3.2.1, Figure 9, Table 5 and Appendix B

parameters.unit_cell: unit square, plane strain, unit reference thickness

execution.evidence: The fixture creates the published geometry with Gmsh physical regions, exact opposite-face periodic node pairing, the public affine-periodic constraint, regional finite-strain J2 materials, model.step, accepted quadrature state, and periodic-cell history. The assessment refuses promotion when any required observable or convergence axis is absent.

observables: Homogenized first-Piola stress in the published column-major order.
Recoverable Hencky elastic energy ELENER, excluding hardening storage and plastic dissipation.
Homogenized algorithmic tangent in the published component order.
Periodic equation mismatch and opposite-face pairing error.
Mesh, plane-strain formulation, cell-size, serial/MPI, and restart convergence evidence.
acceptance: First-Piola stress, recoverable elastic energy, and effective tangent must each satisfy the declared 3 percent relative-error contract.
The result must be converged with respect to mesh and the numerical plane-strain representation; the current thin-extrusion route must include thickness convergence.
The 1x1, 1x2, 2x1, and 2x2 cells must preserve the published cell-size invariance.
Serial and MPI execution and checkpoint/restart must preserve the accepted response.
Missing evidence produces incomplete; any available observable outside tolerance produces failed.
limitations: The publication uses a mixed displacement--pressure 9/3 element to avoid locking from incompressible plastic flow. The current fixture lowers the problem through displacement-only P1 tetrahedra in a thin three-dimensional extrusion; this is the leading diagnosis and still requires a locking-resistant A/B confirmation.

The published elastic inclusions are represented in the shared regional transaction by the same J2 provider with an intentionally unreachable yield stress; they remain elastic over the declared path but are not a distinct elastic constitutive implementation.
Coarse diagnostic runs preserve exact periodic kinematics and small Hill--Mandel residuals but do not reproduce Table 5 within tolerance; the benchmark is therefore not promoted.
A production mixed finite-strain J2 plane-strain route and a homogenized consistent tangent remain required before this external gate can pass.
